title: ODS Release Index
description: The release index lists TRUD's releases and the datasets built from each. Schema rules that JSON Schema cannot express — that release dates are unique and ordered newest first, that dataset versions within a release are unique SemVer strings ordered oldest first, and that merge operations refuse contradicted digests, hashes, sizes, or a changed signing key fingerprint — are enforced by ods itself as the authority.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema describing this release index format.

trud_signing_key_fingerprint.description: Upper-case 40-character hexadecimal SHA-1 fingerprint of NHS England's TRUD PGP signing key used to verify release archives. Pinned from NHS England's distribution signing key; immutable anchor that never changes once recorded. Merge refuses any index with a changed fingerprint.
trud_signing_key_fingerprint.$comment: NHS England signs source archives with RSA key 71ED5964BAE53E83556320A42BE59DADEE84BEB0. Pinned in the index so archives can still be verified if TRUD goes offline.

mirrors.description: Ordered list of OCI registry mirror base URLs where release blobs and manifests can be fetched. Comes from configured upstream distribution mirrors (e.g. ods.fyi, ghcr.io); can be replaced when a fetched index provides a non-empty list of mirrors.

url.description: Base URL of the mirror registry.

releases.description: List of TRUD release records and the datasets built from each, ordered newest date first. Aggregated from TRUD publication archives and ods dataset builds; append-only list where existing dates cannot be removed or reordered.

trud_release_date.description: The publication date of the TRUD release archive in YYYY-MM-DD format. Extracted from NHS England TRUD release metadata; immutable release date key that never changes once recorded.

trud_release_sha256.description: Upper-case 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 hash of the original TRUD source archive ZIP file published by NHS England. Computed from the downloaded source archive and verified against TRUD's signed release manifest; immutable hash that never changes once recorded. Merge refuses contradiction.
trud_release_sha256.$comment: trud_release_file is not stored because zip filenames are arbitrary and mutable; archives are identified strictly by hash. The SHA-1 hash signed by NHS in their release manifest is also not stored as SHA-256 is our primary integrity guarantee.

trud_release_filesize_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the original TRUD source archive ZIP file, greater than zero. Measured from the downloaded TRUD ZIP archive; immutable size that never changes once recorded. Merge refuses contradiction.

datasets.description: List of verified datasets built from this TRUD source release, ordered oldest dataset version first. Built and published by ods make release; append-only list that only grows as new versions are built and published. Existing versions can never be removed.

dataset_version.description: Semantic version string (SemVer) of the dataset build, e.g. 0.1.0. Set from the ods tool version at build time; immutable version key that never changes once recorded.

manifest_digest.description: Content-addressed OCI manifest digest formatted as 'sha256:' followed by 64 lower-case hex characters. Computed from the dataset manifest generated and published by ods make release; immutable digest that never changes once recorded. Merge refuses contradiction.

dataset_doi.description: Optional Digital Object Identifier (DOI) assigned to this dataset release on Zenodo. Assigned after archival publishing; optional field that may appear later and never contradicts once set.

withdrawn.description: Optional advisory explanation if this dataset version was withdrawn due to corruption or data defect. Set by maintainers if a defect is identified; optional field that may appear later and never contradicts.
